about: The math film's script: what stretto estimates and why, the rule that decides a lookup, the counts behind it, alpha's posterior as a fugue program, the bindings, and how the estimate behaved: calibration, the threshold sweep, the ceiling, live turns and learning. Chapters (`beats`) of lines, as the explainer's: `text` is the caption, `say` what the voice says, `em` the phrases lit in petrol, `post` the pause after a line. Every formula is the paper's (paper/stretto.md) or the code's; every number is the paper's, the claims ledger's, the walkthrough's, a published row's (data/results.py) or fugue's own run on the console's fixtures (data/), with its scope on screen. narrate.py voices it (math-video).

lines.text: The math inside stretto, as the code computes it.
One event to estimate, one rule to act on it, and how well both held up.
A lookup pays off if the agent uses it before its next write.
So the quantity to estimate is q: the chance a read is among those the agent makes before it writes.
It is never smaller than the chance the read comes next, because a reply can come between.
After a user's details, the habit put an order next at 0.64. The agents read one before the write 94% of the time.
lines.say: After a user's details, the habit put an order next at zero point six four. The agents read one before the write ninety-four percent of the time.

lines.text: After an order, a product came next at 0.08, but before the write 38% of the time.
lines.say: After an order, a product came next at zero point zero eight, but before the write thirty-eight percent of the time.

lines.text: A flow makes only reads, and reads leave the state as it was.
If the agent makes the same calls, every write lands on the same state.
A wrong lookup changes only what the agent reads. Its worst case is a detour.
Used, a lookup saves a turn, worth beta. Unused, it is a detour, which costs delta.
Its expected value is the saving, q times beta, less the expected detour, one minus q, times delta.
As q rises, the saving grows and the detour shrinks. They balance at delta over beta plus delta.
Live on τ²-bench, 260 saved turns saved 1.56 million input tokens, and 17 detours carried 43,000.
lines.say: Live on tau two bench, 260 saved turns saved 1.56 million input tokens, and 17 detours carried 43,000.

lines.text: That is about 6,000 a turn and 2,530 a detour, so the line sits at 0.30.
lines.say: That is about 6,000 a turn, and 2,530 a detour, so the line sits at zero point three zero.

lines.text: Counted in airline and telecom, where detours are shorter, it sits at 0.12 to 0.13.
lines.say: Counted in airline and telecom, where detours are shorter, it sits at zero point one two to zero point one three.

lines.text: The chances come from counts. Each step becomes its tool, its outcome, and a feature of its result.
The habit predicts the next step from the last two, and backs off to shorter contexts.
Each context is a Dirichlet–multinomial: its counts, plus alpha times what the shorter context predicts.
lines.say: Each context is a Dirichlet multinomial: its counts, plus alpha times what the shorter context predicts.

lines.text: In the quickstart's sessions, each longer context sharpens the guess that an order comes next.
Turn alpha up, and the prior takes over. Turn it down, and the counts do.
The probability of use counts the same contexts for a different event: each read made before the next write.
Each tool is its own coin, so these chances need not sum to one.
Alpha sets how fast the counts outweigh the prior. stretto doesn't tune it by hand.
It infers it with fugue, a probabilistic programming library for Rust.
The program draws log alpha from a normal prior, and scores the sessions one step at a time.
Prior times likelihood is the posterior.
Metropolis–Hastings walks it, and the draws pile up into its shape.
lines.say: Metropolis Hastings walks it, and the draws pile up into its shape.

lines.text: On the quickstart's six sessions, the median is 0.70: the alpha the flow was learned with.
lines.say: On the quickstart's six sessions, the median is zero point seven zero: the alpha the flow was learned with.

lines.text: A lookup also needs its arguments. stretto counts where each one came from.
A binding's chance is right over tried, with one added to the right and two to the tried: a uniform prior.
Each binding tried narrows it: 12 right of 14 gives 0.81.
lines.say: Each binding tried narrows it: twelve right of fourteen gives zero point eight one.

lines.text: The decision multiplies the two: the read's chance, times its arguments', against the line.
A chance is calibrated if lookups scored 0.7 are used seven times in ten.
lines.say: A chance is calibrated if lookups scored zero point seven are used seven times in ten.

lines.text: Scored on the next step, retail's lookups sit above the line. The next step understates use.
Scored on use before the next write, they sit closer to it.
The calibration error fell in every domain. In retail, from 0.164 to 0.083. Lower is better.
lines.say: The calibration error fell in every domain. In retail, from zero point one six four to zero point zero eight three. Lower is better.

lines.text: Better chances make better decisions. Here is each threshold's net saving, for GLM-5 in retail.
lines.say: Better chances make better decisions. Here is each threshold's net saving, for G L M five in retail.

lines.text: Deciding on use before the write peaks at the counted line, and falls slowly past it.
The next-step rule falls away past one half, where its chances seldom reach.
Over nine agents it never saw, it takes 86.4% of retail's ceiling: 10.2 points more than the next-step rule.
lines.say: Over nine agents it never saw, it takes eighty-six point four percent of retail's ceiling: ten point two points more than the next-step rule.

lines.text: Live, with no model of its own, it cut GLM-5.3's LLM turns by 27.9% over 28 tasks.
lines.say: Live, with no model of its own, it cut G L M five point three's L L M turns by twenty-seven point nine percent over twenty-eight tasks.

lines.text: Each line is one task, before and after. 23 of the 28 took fewer turns.
lines.say: Each line is one task, before and after. Twenty-three of the twenty-eight took fewer turns.

lines.text: And in replay, it learns fast: ten of an agent's own sessions give 96% of what all of them do in retail.
lines.say: And in replay, it learns fast: ten of an agent's own sessions give ninety-six percent of what all of them do in retail.
em: ten of an agent's own sessions

lines.text: A flow is audited as a program too.
Each decision is a categorical choice at its own address: a lookup, handing back, or another step.
fugue scores the agent's real path under it, in nats of surprise per decision.
The paper gives the proofs and every benchmark number. The worked examples are the walkthrough's and the quickstart's.
